title: Fast Reading
subtitle: Read faster, one word at a time.
sampleText: Reading quickly is a skill you can train. Words appear one by one in the same spot, so your eyes never have to move across the line. Start slowly, then raise the speed whenever it feels comfortable. Take a break when you get tired.
